names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's life for the ten martyrs of 9 august, which names the company's members: «Iulian, Marchian, Ioan, Iacov, Alexie, Dimitrie, Foca, Petru și Leontie» and «Maria patriciana».

Read out of saint.gr's page for the ten who suffered at the Chalke Gate, whose head line for this one is «Αγιος Ιωαννης Που Μαρτυρησε Στη Χαλκη» and whose enumeration reads «Ιωάννης»; the rank word and the clause about the martyrdom are left off.

Name page 982 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Иоанн Константинопольский, мч.»; the rank is stripped and the epithet the page prints is kept. The day line gives the forename alone, in the genitive, inside a list of eleven.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 августа ст. ст. — «Мчч. Иулиана, Маркиана, Иоанна, Иакова, Алексия, Димитрия, Фотия, Петра, Леонтия, Марии патрикии, протоспафария Григория и двух юношей, за икону Христа пострадавших (730).»

attestations.note: The line's third name, «Иоанна». One of the nine noblemen the reading says were imprisoned, beaten and beheaded. One of the eleven names the day's fifth entry enumerates, all of them behind one reading, life4410, «Мученики Иулиан, Маркиан, Иоанн, Иаков, Алексий, Димитрий, Фотий, Петр, Леонтий, Мария патрикия, протоспафарий Григорий и прочие». The eleventh name, the protospatharios Gregory, is the only one the corpus did not hold and lands as a new folder in batch ru-08-09-1; this row is one of the other ten. THE TWO YOUTHS ARE NOT FOLDERED: the line closes «и двух юношей» and names neither, and neither does the reading. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN where the folder had none: the line's «(730)» and the reading's «пострадали за святые иконы в 730 году» are one year for a company whose members died at different removes from the event — Gregory at once, these nine after eight months' imprisonment, Maria by giving herself up afterwards — and this wave has not written a first date for a folder off a company's single year. `day-candidates.mjs` marked the line `[~]` and it enumerates eleven people. The day page prints no hymn under any of these names. A `related` row to `gregory-the-protospatharios` is added, which is the eleventh man of this same line and of this same reading.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 august — «Sfinții 10 Mucenici Mărturisitori pentru icoana lui Hristos»

attestations.note: The day page prints the company as one line, «Sfinții 10 Mucenici Mărturisitori pentru icoana lui Hristos», and the life behind it enumerates its members: nine men by name — Iulian, Marchian, Ioan, Iacov, Alexie, Dimitrie, Foca, Petru, Leontie — and «Maria patriciana», beheaded with them. One folder per named member follows docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. The nun Theodosia, taken with them, is kept by the same page on 29 mai and is not a folder here.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στη Χάλκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and saint.gr serves one page for the whole company, enumerating it: «Τα δε ονόματά τους ήταν τα έξης: Ιουλιανός, Μαρκιανός, Ιωάννης, Ιάκωβος, Αλέξιος, Δημήτριος, Φώτιος, Πέτρος, Λεόντιος και Μαρία η Πατρικία». The corpus already keeps the ten as ten folders from the Romanian pass, so each takes its own greek row and no folder is split or merged here. The page sets the occasion under Leo the Third and his edict of 728 and gives no year of death, so no `dates` object is proposed; it prints no hymn of any kind. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
